The GEL-CUMULUS™ 25 running shoe is a great choice if you want a shoe with extra cushioning. Our lightest and most cushioned GEL-CUMULUS™ shoe yet, its comfort will put your mind at ease during your run.

The shoes PureGEL™ technology improves softness and shock absorption to reduce the impact on your joints. And weve increased the amount of FF BLAST™ PLUS foam. This is made possible thanks to the updated midsole design, which allows more foam to be placed for added comfort.

What makes GEL-CUMULUS™ 25 running shoe comfortable?

Internalised PureGEL™ technology improves softness and shock absorption to reduce the impact on your joints.
More FF BLAST™ PLUS foam creates a softer and more comfortable running experience.
Updated midsole design allows for more foam to ensure even more comfort.
What else makes the GEL-CUMULUS™ 25 shoe a great choice?

This shoe is designed with comfort in mind, and we’ve spent hours testing it at our Institute of Sports Science ISS in Japan. The GEL-CUMULUS™ 25 running shoe includes additional technical features to support you during your runs, which you’ll find listed under ‘Tech Features’ below.

PureGEL technology
Improves softness and shock absorption to reduce impact.
FF BLAST PLUS foam
Provides lightweight, premium cushioning for added comfort.
Updated midsole design
Allows for more foam to ensure even more comfort.
Reflective details
Helps improve visibility during low-light conditions.
AHAR outsole rubber
Provides great traction and durability.
Jacquard mesh upper
Helps improve breathability and comfort
OrthoLite X-30 sockliner
Provides soft step-in comfort.

The Saucony Endorphin Speed 4 Men’s Running Shoes in Navy (S20940-211) are designed for performance-oriented runners offering a balance of speed comfort and versatility. This is the fourth iteration of the highly popular Endorphin Speed series known for being a lightweight yet cushioned shoe that suits both training and racing.

Key Features:

  1. Cushioning:
    • The PWRRUN PB foam midsole provides lightweight cushioning with exceptional energy return making the shoes responsive and efficient. This cushioning material is springy and helps propel runners forward with each stride.
  2. Speedroll Technology:
    • Saucony’s Speedroll technology is designed to create a forward-rolling motion encouraging a quicker turnover and helping runners move efficiently at faster speeds. It gives the sensation of being “rocked” forward as you run promoting a smooth fast stride.
  3. Nylon Plate:
    • Unlike carbon-plated shoes the Endorphin Speed 4 uses a flexible nylon plate which provides both structure and speed. This plate is designed to offer a more forgiving feel while still maintaining the benefits of a propulsive ride ideal for a mix of training and racing.
  4. Upper Construction:
    • The engineered mesh upper is lightweight and breathable ensuring your feet stay cool and comfortable during runs. It has been updated for a snug yet flexible fit.
    • FORMFIT technology ensures that the shoe conforms to your foot’s natural shape providing a locked-in and secure fit.
  5. Outsole Durability:
    • The rubber outsole is strategically placed in high-wear areas to enhance durability and provide excellent traction on different surfaces making it suitable for both road and light trail running.
  6. Weight:
    • One of the key selling points of the Endorphin Speed 4 is its lightweight design making it an excellent choice for speedwork long-distance races and even daily training runs.
  7. Heel-to-toe Drop:
    • It features an 8mm heel-to-toe drop promoting a natural stride while still providing sufficient cushioning under the heel.

Aesthetic and Design:

  • The Navy colorway (S20940-211) is sleek and modern combining a professional look with performance features. The shoe has clean lines with subtle branding making it visually appealing while maintaining a performance-driven design.

Ideal for:

  • Runners looking for speed: Perfect for those who want a lightweight shoe that can handle fast paces.

Nike react technology is a lightweight, durable foam that delivers a smooth, responsive ride.

Smooth and steady

Cushioned feel, higher stacks

More benefits

As recreational running established widespread popularity in the 1970s, the benchmark for running footwear shifted from mere existence to performance. While the era’s designs would be considered simple by today’s standards, the decade stands out as the moment when running shoes truly came into their own. Absolute response

Nike React foam offers incredibly elastic gait. When the foot comes in contact with the ground, the foam responds to your step with excellent elasticity. The more energy you put into your step, the more energy is returned. Compared to the Nike Lunarlon anti-vibration protection that offers a similar soft feel, React foam returns 13% more energy.


Always like the first time
